title: AI labs sitting on ‘bombshell’ revelations that could cause global chaos, experts warn
summary: Exclusive: AI may have cracked decades-old maths problems that underpin encryption at banks and government agencies AI companies are sitting on “bombshell” revelations that could disrupt a cornerstone of security for banks and governments in as soon as a few months, leading experts believe. Scott Aaronson, a pre-eminent theoretical computer scientist, told the Guardian there were “well-attested rumours” that powerful artificial intelligence models had broken ground on decades-old maths problems related to how the world encodes secret information.
